title: Eric Young’s breakthrough meets Lashley’s dominance
summary: Eric Young escapes his underdog role to win the world title. MVP’s alliance with Lashley and Kenny King turns the celebration into a fight against a new power bloc.

chapters.title: Young wins the world championship
chapters.result: Eric Young defeats Magnus to win the TNA world title.
chapters.context: After winning a contender’s gauntlet earlier in the night, Young cashes in the opportunity immediately and achieves his career breakthrough.

chapters.title: Lashley takes control of the title
chapters.result: Lashley defeats Eric Young for the TNA world championship.
chapters.context: Backed by MVP and Kenny King, Lashley ends Young’s reign and places the title at the center of their alliance’s power.
